news.headline: NeurAxis Completes Stock Option-for-RSU Exchange, Discloses New Executive Grants
news.summary: The previously approved option exchange became effective July 24, 2026, converting 1,319,394 outstanding stock options into RSUs 1-for-1 under the 2022 Omnibus Plan; on August 13 the company also granted new three-year vesting RSUs to CEO Brian Carrico, CFO Timothy Henrichs, and other executives.

news.headline: NRXS Stock Dips Post Q2 Earnings Despite Revenue Surge, Gross Margin Up
news.summary: Shares fell roughly 8-9% in the days after Q2 results even though revenue jumped 116% and gross margin expanded to 85.9% from 83.6%, as the $1.93M revenue print landed slightly below a thin two-analyst consensus of about $2M.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Revenue Up 116% Year Over Year
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue reached $1.9M (up 115.7% YoY), IB-Stim unit deliveries grew 60% and average selling price rose 28% to $992/device, reflecting continued benefit from the Category I CPT code for PENFS that took effect January 1, 2026; H1 2026 revenue totaled $3.6M, up 98% YoY.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Mid-Atlantic Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for PENFS/IB-Stim representing over 500,000 covered lives in the Mid-Atlantic region, part of its push toward comprehensive nationwide written payer coverage.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on August 11
news.summary: Company confirmed it would report Q2 2026 results before market open on August 11, 2026, with a management conference call at 9:00am ET the same day.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results and business update call; company has posted eight consecutive quarters of double-digit YoY revenue growth heading in.

catalysts.label: Continued payer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis is actively adding regional insurer medical policies for PENFS/IB-Stim (most recently Mid-Atlantic, >500K lives in August) as it works toward comprehensive nationwide written coverage.

catalysts.label: Category I CPT code ramp
catalysts.detail: Full-year benefit of the AMA Category I CPT code for PENFS (effective Jan 1, 2026) continuing to drive reimbursement, ASP gains, and gross margin expansion.

catalysts.label: RED (Rectal Expulsion Device) commercialization progress
catalysts.detail: Company's second product line targeting rectal hypersensitivity/neuromuscular evaluation; watch for updates on adoption alongside IB-Stim in future earnings calls.

pulse: As of 2026-08-25, no NeurAxis-specific news has been confirmed beyond the August 19 option-for-RSU exchange 8-K and the post-Q2-earnings stock dip on August 14 - searches for the intervening week (Aug 20-25) turned up nothing new. Fundamentally the story remains intact: record Q2 revenue (+116% YoY) and margin expansion, though shares sold off on a narrow miss versus thin analyst consensus. Near-term watch items are continued payer-coverage additions and the next quarterly print, likely in November.
